lines.en: label mayadorm10:
I knock on the door and wait to see if there’s an answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲门，等着看有没有人应。

lines.en: And while I'm here to see Maya, I elect to not call out her name as Ami could also be behind the door and I don't want anyone to die today.
lines.zh: 虽然我是来找 Maya 的，但我选择不喊她的名字——门后也可能有 Ami，而我今天不想闹出人命。

lines.en: Granted, I also feel like calling out Maya's name would decrease my chances of being let into the room, so staying silent here really is just the safest bet.
lines.zh: 当然，我也觉得喊出 Maya 的名字会降低我被放进屋的几率，所以保持沉默在这里真的是最保险的选择。

lines.en: : Who is it?
Ami’s voice rings out from what sounds like the back of the room, prompting me to believe that she's already in bed.
lines.zh: Ami 的声音从听起来像是房间深处传来，让我相信她已经躺下了。

lines.en: That, paired with the fact that it wasn't Maya who responded, signals to me that it might be best to just leave at this point.
lines.zh: 这一点，再加上不是 Maya 应答，都暗示我此刻最好直接走人。

lines.en: But, then again, a girl is a girl. And if I close my eyes, I'm sure their bodies would feel the same anyway.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，女孩就是女孩。而且我敢肯定，只要我闭上眼，她们的身体感觉起来都一样。

lines.en: : It’s me. Can I come in?
lines.zh: : 是我。我能进来吗？

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Of course you can, Sensei! Don't listen to Maya!
lines.zh: : 当然可以啊，老师！别听 Maya 的！

lines.en: : Listen to Maya.
lines.zh: : 听 Maya 的。

lines.en: : The door is open! You can come in whenever you want!
lines.zh: : 门没锁！你想什么时候进来都行！

lines.en: scene black
: No. You-
lines.zh: : 不。你不——

lines.en: scene mayadormten1
: ...Can't.
: Surprise.
lines.zh: : 惊喜。

lines.en: : Why must you always do the exact opposite of what I want you to do?
lines.zh: : 你为什么总是做跟我想要你做的完全相反的事？

lines.en: : Because the opposite of what you want me to do is always more fun.
lines.zh: : 因为跟你想要我做的相反的事，总是更有意思。

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei. What brings you here tonight?
lines.zh: : 嘿，老师。你今晚来这儿干什么？

lines.en: : Not much. I was just in the area and figured I'd drop by to check in on you two.
lines.zh: : 没什么。我刚好在附近，就想顺路来看看你们俩。

lines.en: And by you two I really just mean Maya since Ami has made it her mission in life for the two of us to always know where the other one is.
lines.zh: 而我说「你们俩」其实只指 Maya，因为 Ami 已把「我俩永远都知道对方在哪儿」当成了她的人生使命。

lines.en: : So, what are you up to?
lines.zh: : 那么，你们在忙什么？

lines.en: : We were just talking. You're welcome to come over here and sit with us, you know. You don't have to just stand there and be all weird.
lines.zh: : 我们刚刚在聊天。欢迎你过来跟我们坐一起啊。你不用就那么站在那儿怪怪的。

lines.en: scene mayadormten2
: Don't even think about it.
lines.zh: : 想都别想。

lines.en: I take a step forward to get underneath the kotatsu when I'm suddenly stopped in my tracks by a gaze that could probably kill me if it was any sharper.
lines.zh: 我往前迈一步，正要钻进被炉，突然被一个眼神钉在原地——再锋利一点，那眼神大概真能杀了我。

lines.en: (Weebnote: A kotatsu is a type of Japanese table with a built in blanket and heat source.)
lines.zh: （死宅注：被炉是一种日式桌子，自带毯子和热源。）

lines.en: (Many years ago, they would be heated by a charcoal brazier, but most of them nowadays are electric.)
lines.zh: （很多年前，它们靠炭盆取暖，不过现在大多是电动的。）

lines.en: : Don't listen to her, Sensei. She might look scary but, deep down, I know she wants you here too.
lines.zh: : 别听她的，老师。她看着吓人，但在心底，我知道她其实也想你在这儿。

lines.en: : I don't know, Ami. That look doesn't exactly scream “I secretly like you.”
lines.zh: : 我不信，Ami。那眼神可一点都不像在喊「我偷偷喜欢你」。

lines.en: : Please continue following that train of thought until you arrive back at your home. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 请顺着这个思路一直走，直到你回到自己家为止。谢谢。

lines.en: scene mayadormten3
: Maya, how come you’re being so mean all of a sudden? You were fine just a minute ago.
lines.zh: : Maya，你怎么突然这么凶？你刚才还好好的。

lines.en: : I was in a good mood a minute ago. That mood has since faded.
lines.zh: : 我刚才心情不错。那份心情已经消散了。

lines.en: : Whatever could have caused this?
lines.zh: : 到底是什么导致的呢？

lines.en: Maya seems even colder than normal today...but I can't remember doing anything in particular that would have set her off.
lines.zh: Maya 今天看起来比平时还要冷……可我想不起我做过什么特别的事会惹到她。

lines.en: Maybe there's just something bothering her in general?
lines.zh: 也许只是有什么东西在整体上烦着她？

lines.en: : I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 我不懂。

lines.en: : In fact, you've been acting pretty weird basically every time he's come up lately and-
lines.zh: : 事实上，最近每次他一出现，你就表现得很怪，而且——

lines.en: scene mayadormten4
: I have not been acting any weirder than normal. I just don't understand why I should feel obligated to spend time with someone I dislike simply because you feel the opposite about them.
lines.zh: : 我表现得一点都不比平时更怪。我只是不明白，为什么仅仅因为你对他看法相反，我就有义务跟一个我讨厌的人待在一起。

lines.en: : I just asked him to sit down. It's not like I'm trying to give him a lap pillow.
lines.zh: : 我只是叫他坐下。又不是要给他膝枕。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I really don’t mind standing.
lines.zh: : 没事。我真不介意站着。

lines.en: scene mayadormten5
: Well, I mind! You’re my [uncle] and if I want you to sit under the kotatsu with us you darn well better.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我介意！你是我的[uncle]，如果我要你跟我们一块儿坐到被炉里，你最好就给我坐。

lines.en: : You shouldn't have to suffer just because Maya decided to be a butt.
lines.zh: : 你不该因为 Maya 决定当个混蛋就受这种罪。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So I'll just be the one to suffer instead. That's fine.
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。那就换我来受这份罪。没关系。

lines.en: : You know, I'm just going to sit down now and hope that this spat boils over.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我现在就坐下，然后祈祷这场争吵自己消停。

lines.en: scene mayadormten6
I sit down and immediately face Maya, ready to make things even worse for her because that is what I do.
lines.zh: 我坐下来，立刻面对 Maya，准备好让她更难受——因为我干的就是这个。

lines.en: : Hey.
: Yes, hello.
lines.zh: : 是的，你好。

lines.en: : Come here often?
lines.zh: : 常来这儿吗？

lines.en: : At the moment, yes. But I'm having second thoughts of ever returning after tonight.
lines.zh: : 此刻是的。但今晚之后，我在认真考虑还要不要再回来。

lines.en: scene mayadormten7
: Don’t you feel so much more comfortable now that you’re nice and warm, Sensei? And to think Maya tried to rob you of this opportunity.
lines.zh: : 老师，你现在暖暖和和的，是不是舒服多了？想想看，Maya 刚才还打算剥夺你这个机会呢。

lines.en: : Well, it’s summer, so...I was kind of warm in the first place. In fact, why are you two even using a kotatsu when it's basically burning outside every day?
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在是夏天，所以……我本来就已经挺热的了。话说回来，外面每天都跟烧着似的，你俩为什么要用被炉？

lines.en: : Having an ice queen who lives in the room tends to make things a little colder.
lines.zh: : 房间里住着一位冰雪女王，会让整体温度偏低。

lines.en: : Wow.
: Fair enough. So, are you guys like...studying or something?
lines.zh: : 有道理。那你们是在……学习什么的吗？

lines.en: scene mayadormten6
: What are we even supposed to study? I can't remember the last time you assigned us any actual work.
lines.zh: : 我们到底能学什么？我都记不起你上次给我们布置正经作业是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Maya, shh. You know that I'll be the one to suffer if Sensei remembers he has a job to do.
lines.zh: : Maya，嘘。你知道要是老师想起来他还有份工作，受苦的会是我。

lines.en: : There are those...standardized test things, right? Maybe you two were in the middle of studying for those?
lines.zh: : 有那些……标准化考试什么的，对吧？也许你俩刚才在为那个备考？

lines.en: : I don't know. I'm just trying to make small talk. Would it kill you to go along with it for a few minutes?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我只是在没话找话。你就不能配合几分钟吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概不能。

lines.en: scene mayadormten7
: Do you know what’s wrong with her today?
lines.zh: : 你知道她今天是怎么了吗？

lines.en: : No clue. Maybe she's just jealous of how much we love each other?
lines.zh: : 不知道。也许她只是嫉妒我俩这么相爱？

lines.en: : First off, ew.
lines.zh: : 首先，恶。

lines.en: : Second, why am I being excluded from a conversation at my own kotatsu?
lines.zh: : 其次，为什么我反而被排除在一场发生在我被炉边的对话之外？

lines.en: scene mayadormten8
: Since when is it just your kotatsu? We bought it together, remember?
lines.zh: : 什么时候这被炉变成「你的」了？我们一起买的，记得吗？

lines.en: : That gives me 50%% ownership. So why am I not allowed to decide who sits at it and who stands?
lines.zh: : 那意味着我有 50% 所有权。那为什么我不能决定谁能坐、谁得站着？

lines.en: : You know, you’re lucky I’m not just getting up and leaving you here with him to punish you for that bad attitude of yours.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我没就这么站起来走人、把你留给他来惩罚你这副臭态度，你就该谢天谢地了。

lines.en: scene mayadormten9
: Good. I don't even want to think about what would happen to me if I were alone in a bedroom with him.
lines.zh: : 好。我根本不想去想要是我俩单独待在一个房间里，我会怎么样。

lines.en: : Probably nothing you don't already want to happen.
lines.zh: : 大概不会发生任何你不本来就希望发生的事。

lines.en: scene mayadormten10
: It never ceases to amaze me how confident you manage to be despite being a complete waste of carbon.
lines.zh: : 你明明是一坨彻头彻尾的碳基废料，却还能这么自信，这件事永远让我惊叹。

lines.en: : It never ceases to amaze me how fun and good at conversation you are.
lines.zh: : 你这么风趣健谈，也永远让我惊叹。

lines.en: : At the very least, please close your eyes while speaking to me. Each second they spend on my body feels like a thousand toothpicks pressed underneath my fingernails.
lines.zh: : 至少，跟我说话的时候请把眼睛闭上。它们在我身上停留的每一秒，都像有一千根牙签压在我的指甲缝底下。

lines.en: scene mayadormten11
: Hmm...
: You know, maybe I will leave after all. It's not like I have anything to worry about. Right, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许我真的该走了。反正我没什么好担心的。对吧，Maya？

lines.en: : Are you not worried about my life? Because leaving the two of us in a room together puts that at serious risk, you know.
lines.zh: : 你不担心我的人身安全吗？因为把我俩留在一个房间里，这事的风险可大了，你知道。

lines.en: : If that's the price that must be paid for two people I love to start getting along with one another, it is a price I must pay.
lines.zh: : 如果那是让两个我爱的人开始和睦相处必须付出的代价，那这代价我必须付。

lines.en: : Hold on. Let me remove all of these toothpicks from underneath my nails so I can have something to poke holes in your backwards logic with.
lines.zh: : 等等。让我先把这些牙签从指甲缝里拔出来，好让我有东西能在你那套颠倒的逻辑上戳几个洞。

lines.en: : Maya, you are going to stay right here with Sensei while I go take a shower. Because if you don't, I will reveal your deepest, darkest secret to everyone in class.
lines.zh: : Maya，你就在这儿跟老师待着，我去洗个澡。因为如果你不，我就把你最深最黑暗的秘密抖给全班。

lines.en: : What secret are you even talking about? There's nothing you know about me that I wouldn't already reveal to everyone on my own.
lines.zh: : 你说的到底是什么秘密？关于我的事，没有什么是你不能自己抖出去的。

lines.en: : I don't know, Maya. What am I talking about?
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Maya。我到底在说什么？

lines.en: : I literally have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我真的毫无头绪。

lines.en: scene mayadormten7
: Sensei, do you promise to be good if I leave you alone with Maya?
lines.zh: : 老师，你保证我把你单独留给 Maya 你会乖乖的？

lines.en: : Please don’t leave. I really don't want to be alone with him.
lines.zh: : 请别走。我真的不想跟他独处。

lines.en: : Sure. I promise to not be inherently evil while you're away.
lines.zh: : 当然。我保证你不在的时候我不会「本质上就很邪恶」。

lines.en: : Great! Then I guess I’ll let you two settle your differences while I go wash my hair.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那我想我就让你俩去化解分歧吧，我去洗头了。

lines.en: scene black
: Ami, stop. You don't have to do this.
lines.zh: : Ami，别。你不必这样。

lines.en: Ami gets up and grabs a change of clothes before hurrying out of the room.
lines.zh: Ami 起身抓了一套换洗衣物，匆匆出了房间。

lines.en: I'm a little surprised that she's okay leaving me completely unattended with another girl, but I guess she's right in saying that there really is nothing to worry about if it's just Maya.
lines.zh: 我有点意外她居然放心把我跟另一个女孩完全无人看管地留在一起，不过我想她说得对：只要对象是 Maya，确实没什么可担心的。

lines.en: scene mayadormten13
: Are you really that afraid of being alone in here with me?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么怕跟我单独待在这儿吗？

lines.en: I decide to just come right out and ask what's on my mind, since this expression doesn't exactly match the typical level of disdain Maya normally shows for me.
lines.zh: 我决定干脆把心里想的直接问出来，因为这个表情跟 Maya 平时对我的那种惯常的轻蔑不太一样。

lines.en: If anything, this seems like genuine worry. But what I don't understand is why.
lines.zh: 要说的话，这更像是真正的担忧。可我不明白为什么。

lines.en: All things considered, my actions toward Maya have been extremely tame thus far. My thoughts? Not so much. But I've acted on literally nothing.
lines.zh: 总的说来，我对 Maya 的行为到现在都极为克制。我的想法？那就不一定了。但我对什么都没付诸行动。

lines.en: So the fact that she's so much more opposed to my presence here and not anywhere on the outside makes me think...
lines.zh: 所以，她对我在这儿的反对比对我在外面任何地方都激烈得多，这让我觉得……

lines.en: Well, I'm not really sure what it makes me think.
lines.zh: 嗯，我不太确定这让我觉得什么。

lines.en: But I was finally starting to believe the two of us had been making progress.
lines.zh: 但我终于开始相信我倆一直在取得进展。

lines.en: Now? I'm not so sure anymore.
lines.zh: 现在？我不太确定了。

lines.en: scene mayadormten14
: Of course I'm afraid of being alone in here with you.
lines.zh: : 我当然怕跟你单独待在这儿。

lines.en: : You're five times my age and three times my size. I fear for my life.
lines.zh: : 你年纪是我五倍，体型是我三倍。我怕有生命危险。

lines.en: : First off, I’m definitely not five times your age.
lines.zh: : 首先，我绝对没有你五倍年纪。

lines.en: : Second, I’m not going to kill you. I like you.
lines.zh: : 其次，我不会杀了你。我喜欢你。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why what?
lines.zh: : 什么为什么？

lines.en: : Why do you like me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么喜欢我？

lines.en: : I avoid you like the plague and you keep coming back. Stop it.
lines.zh: : 我像躲瘟疫一样躲你，你却一直回来。住手。

lines.en: : It’s annoying. It’s repulsive. You’re a disgusting man who can't make it so much as an hour without hitting on a teenage girl.
lines.zh: : 这很烦人。这很恶心。你是个恶心的男人，连一个小时都撑不过就要撩一下青春期女孩。

lines.en: : I should report you to the police.
lines.zh: : 我该去报警。

lines.en: : Is it a crime for a teacher to try and get to know his students?
lines.zh: : 老师想多了解自己的学生，这也算犯罪？

lines.en: : Do you truly expect me to believe that's what's happening here? Because if so, you're even more pathetic than you look. Which is extremely pathetic, just so you know.
lines.zh: : 你真指望我相信这就是这儿正在发生的事？因为如果是，那你比看上去还要可悲。顺便告诉你，你已经极其可悲了。

lines.en: : I'm not going to do anything, you know. I'll even let you tie my hands behind my back if you're that afraid of me making a move.
lines.zh: : 我不会做什么的，你知道的。你要是真那么怕我动手，我甚至让你把我双手绑在背后。

lines.en: : Oh, yes. Fantastic idea. Indulging your disgusting fetishes is exactly what I need to make me more comfortable right now.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。真是个好主意。纵容你那恶心的癖好，正是让我现在更舒服所需要的东西。

lines.en: : What will make you more comfortable, then? Because you can't just keep avoiding me like this forever.
lines.zh: : 那什么才能让你更舒服？因为你不能永远这样躲我。

lines.en: : See, that's just the thing. I can do that. And I have been doing that for a very long time.
lines.zh: : 瞧，问题就在这儿。我可以永远躲下去。而且我已经躲了很久很久了。

lines.en: : It can't be that long? You don't look a day older than-
lines.zh: : 能有多久？你看起来一天都没比——

lines.en: : Time is relative. The specifics don't matter. What does matter is that everything I have been doing to try and keep you away from me lately has had the exact opposite effect.
lines.zh: : 时间是相对的。具体多久不重要。重要的是，我近来为了让你离我远点所做的一切，全都起了完全相反的效果。

lines.en: : Well, if that's the case, maybe you should try doing the opposite?
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果是这样，也许你该试试反着来？

lines.en: scene mayadormten14r
: Are...are you saying that by spending more time with you, it could make you want to see me less?
lines.zh: : 你……你是在说，花更多时间跟你待在一起，反而能让你更不想见我？

lines.en: : I guess so. It's not like what you're doing now is working at all, right?
lines.zh: : 我想是的。反正你现在做的完全没用，对吧？

lines.en: : That...
: No. That's ridiculous. I'm not the one who needs to change anything. You are. That is the way this works.
lines.zh: : 不。那很荒唐。需要改变的不是我。是你。这才是规则。

lines.en: : The way what works? Your...weird cycle theory or whatever it was?
lines.zh: : 什么规则？你的……怪循环理论还是别的什么？

lines.en: scene mayadormten14
: It's not weird, it's the way things work...
lines.zh: : 不怪，事情就是这样运转的……

lines.en: : Do you really not realize what your relation to me is?
lines.zh: : 你真的不知道你对我的意义是什么吗？

lines.en: : No, I really don't. In fact, you’re the only one I’m confused about right now. I know where I stand with all of the other girls.
lines.zh: : 不，我真的不知道。事实上，现在唯一让我困惑的就是你。我跟其他所有女孩处在什么位置，我都很清楚。

lines.en: : Ugh...
: You truly are pathetic.
lines.zh: : 你真是可悲到家了。

lines.en: scene black
Maya lets out a heavy sigh before tearing herself away from the kotatsu and moving toward the door.
lines.zh: Maya 重重叹了口气，然后从被炉边挣脱，朝门口走去。

lines.en: Expecting her to try and leave, I get up as well to stop her. But when she comes to a halt in front of her desk, I realize that the two of us aren't done here yet.
lines.zh: 我以为她要离开，于是也起身想拦住她。可当她在自己书桌前停下时，我意识到我俩在这儿还没完。

lines.en: scene mayadormten17
: What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 你在干什么？

lines.en: : I got up to get away from you.
lines.zh: : 我起身是为了离你远点。

lines.en: : Sorry. It felt weird sitting alone.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。一个人坐着感觉怪怪的。

lines.en: : It felt weird sitting together too.
lines.zh: : 一起坐着也怪怪的。

lines.en: : I don’t think so at all.
lines.zh: : 我一点都不觉得。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不？

lines.en: : Because I like you.
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢你。

lines.en: scene mayadormten18
: Do you hear yourself right now?
lines.zh: : 你听见自己刚才说的话了吗？

lines.en: : There are nine other girls lining up for you and you’re wasting your time on the one that doesn’t want to be near you.
lines.zh: : 有另外九个女孩排队等你，而你把时间浪费在一个不想靠近你的人身上。

lines.en: : Did being reincarnated scramble your brain or something? Because that would be the only explanation for this that makes any semblance of sense whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 转世是不是把你脑子搅乱了？因为那是唯一能解释这一切的说法了。

lines.en: : I mean, it's possible. I really have no way of confirming or denying that.
lines.zh: : 我是说，有可能。我真的没法证实或否认。

lines.en: : Also, stop overanalyzing the fact that I said I like you. That could mean a multitude of things.
lines.zh: : 还有，别过度分析我说「喜欢你」这件事。那可能意味着很多种意思。

lines.en: : With you? Yeah, no. You saying you like someone can really only mean one thing. You're not trying to be friends, you're trying to get into my pants.
lines.zh: : 从你嘴里说出来？不。你说喜欢一个人只可能意味着一件事。你不是想交朋友，你是想上我的裤子。

lines.en: : Everyone else didn't have any trouble believing that I wanted to be friends.
lines.zh: : 其他人可一点都没难信过我想交朋友。

lines.en: : Everyone else is everyone else. They have nothing to do with me.
lines.zh: : 其他人是其他人。她们跟我无关。

lines.en: : So what you're saying is that we can literally never get close? Not even if I do everything correctly and...according to your standards?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，我们字面意义上永远无法走近？就算我把每件事都做对、而且……照你的标准来也不行？

lines.en: scene mayadormten19
: That is exactly correct.
lines.zh: : 完全正确。

lines.en: : We can never be anything.
lines.zh: : 我们永远不能成为任何关系。

lines.en: : Our paths must remain separate. And we must continue down them until they reach their ends. Only turning around to walk back in the direction we started from.
lines.zh: : 我们的路必须保持分离。我们必须沿着它们一直走到尽头。然后才转过身，朝我们出发的方向走回去。

lines.en: : That is how I want things to be.
lines.zh: : 这就是我希望的样子。

lines.en: : So, for the last time, please stop trying to-
lines.zh: : 所以，最后一次，请你别再试图——

lines.en: : No.
scene mayadormten20
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : No.
: I’m not going to stop trying to talk to you just because you have some weird outlook on life.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你有什么怪人生观就停止试图跟你说话。

lines.en: : Can you stop calling it an outlook when I know for a fact that's just the way things are?
lines.zh: : 你能不能别叫它「人生观」？我明明清楚事实就是那样。

lines.en: : So what?
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？

lines.en: : What do you mean so what? Do you have any idea what sort of things could happen if you just start doing whatever you want?
lines.zh: : 「那又怎样」是什么意思？你知不知道，如果你就这么开始想干什么就干什么，会发生什么事？

lines.en: : No. But I'm not really sure you do either.
lines.zh: : 不知道。不过我也不太确定你知道。

lines.en: : I'm not going to just believe you because you're confidently saying you know the way things work. No one can know the way things work. Life isn't that simple.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你自信地说自己懂规则就信你。没人能懂规则。人生没那么简单。

lines.en: : You have no idea what you're talking about...
lines.zh: : 你根本不知道自己在说什么……

lines.en: : Maybe I don't. But I don't like your outlook, so I'm going to keep wasting my time on you.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。但我不喜欢你的「人生观」，所以我会继续在你身上浪费时间。

lines.en: : If you don't like that, just keep avoiding me. But don't expect me to give up just because you know how things work.
lines.zh: : 如果你不喜欢，就继续躲我。但别指望我会因为你「懂规则」就放弃。

lines.en: scene mayadormten20r
: You are so unfathomably frustrating that it makes me want to pull my hair out.
lines.zh: : 你让人抓狂到我想把头发揪下来。

lines.en: : You think so? Because I thought I sounded pretty cool just now.
lines.zh: : 你真这么想？因为我刚才觉得自己听起来挺酷的。

lines.en: : Of course you thought that. You’re a creep. A newborn trapped in an adult’s body.
lines.zh: : 你当然这么觉得。你是个变态。一个被困在大人身体里的新生儿。

lines.en: : I can guarantee you that newborns have nowhere near the libido I do.
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证，新生儿的性欲跟我没法比。

lines.en: scene mayadormten18
: Seriously, how do you fall asleep at night?
lines.zh: : 说真的，你晚上到底怎么睡得着的？

lines.en: : The same way you do, probably. After a heated bout of self-pleasure and-
lines.zh: : 大概跟你一样吧。来一轮激烈的自我取悦之后——

lines.en: : Please leave. Immediately. I’m tired of this conversation and I want to go to bed.
lines.zh: : 请离开。马上。我受够这场对话了，我想睡觉。

lines.en: : Is that code for you wanting to-
lines.zh: : 那是不是你想——的暗号？

lines.en: : No. It's code for me wanting to close my eyes and forget any of this ever happened.
lines.zh: : 不是。那是我想闭上眼睛、忘掉这一切曾发生过的暗号。

lines.en: : Maya, come on.
lines.zh: : Maya，别这样。

lines.en: scene mayadormten20r
: Just go. Please.
lines.zh: : 走吧。求你了。

lines.en: : Fine. But can I at least ask you something first?
lines.zh: : 行。不过我能先问你一件事吗？

lines.en: : No. You always want to ask me something. I’m tired of answering your questions.
lines.zh: : 不行。你总想问我什么。我受够回答你的问题了。

lines.en: : You’ve been given a new life. Stop wasting it.
lines.zh: : 你被赐予了一次新生。别再浪费它。

lines.en: : I don’t want to be dragged into something that should not exist in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我不想被拖进一个本就不该存在的东西里。

lines.en: : If I wasn't reincarnated...and this was actually my real body and my real personality...
lines.zh: : 如果我没有转世……而这其实是我真正的身体、真正的性格……

lines.en: : Would that change anything at all?
lines.zh: : 那会有什么改变吗？

lines.en: : Or would you still be treating me like some sort of plague?
lines.zh: : 还是说，你依然会把我当成某种瘟疫一样对待？

lines.en: scene mayadormten21
: I already told you that I'm tired of answering your questions...
lines.zh: : 我已经说过我受够回答你的问题了……

lines.en: : I don’t want anything to do with you. Any version of you.
lines.zh: : 我不想跟你有任何关系。任何版本的你。

lines.en: : And I’ll tell you once again that this isn’t going to stop me.
lines.zh: : 而我要再告诉你一次，这阻止不了我。

lines.en: : It should.
lines.zh: : 它应该能。

lines.en: : But I guess there's no use whining about it if you're going to remain just as stubborn and obnoxious as always.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，如果你依然跟往常一样固执又讨厌，那抱怨也没用。

lines.en: : Do whatever you want. Just don’t expect me to go along with it.
lines.zh: : 你想干什么就干什么。只是别指望我会配合。

lines.en: Did...
Did I just win?
lines.zh: 我刚才是不是赢了？

lines.en: Is this what it looks like to successfully tire Maya out?
lines.zh: 成功把 Maya 耗到没脾气，就是这个样子吗？

lines.en: Because, if that's the case, maybe the two of us-
lines.zh: 因为如果是这样，也许我俩——

lines.en: : Oh, and if you think this means that there's a possibility for the two of us to be friends, you’re dead wrong.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你以为这意味着我俩有可能成为朋友，那你大错特错。

lines.en: : I still have no intention of getting to know you. I’m just tired of wasting my breath and I want to go to sleep at a reasonable hour.
lines.zh: : 我依然没有任何想了解你的打算。我只是受够浪费口水了，而且我想在合理的时间睡觉。

lines.en: Damn.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: : Well, on that note...I guess I’ll leave.
lines.zh: : 好吧，说到这个……我想我该走了。

lines.en: : Fantastic. That's the best news I've gotten all year.
lines.zh: : 好极了。这是我今年听过最好的消息。

lines.en: : Tell Ami I'm sorry that her mission to bring us closer didn't go according to plan.
lines.zh: : 替我告诉 Ami，很遗憾她让我们变亲近的计划没成功。

lines.en: : Or perhaps Ami knew that this was going to happen...and that's why she decided to put us together in the first place.
lines.zh: : 或者，也许 Ami 早就知道会这样……所以当初才故意把我们凑到一起。

lines.en: : Perhaps. But that's assuming she's a lot smarter than she actually is. And this is Ami we're talking about.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。不过那是假设她比实际上聪明得多。而我们说的可是 Ami。

lines.en: : Just go already...
lines.zh: : 快走吧……

lines.en: : I don't want to do this anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不想再继续了。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine.
: Goodnight, Maya.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Maya。

lines.en: I manage to make it out of the dorms without bumping into anyone else.
lines.zh: 我没撞上别人，顺利走出了宿舍。

lines.en: Once again, I have no idea if the two of us made any progress or not, but I'm glad I was actually able to speak my mind this time.
lines.zh: 再一次，我不知道我俩到底有没有取得进展，不过我很高兴这次我真的把心里话说出来了。

lines.en: Or...at least part of it.
lines.zh: 或者……至少一部分。

lines.en: To be honest, there's a lot more I want to say to her. I just haven't really sorted any of it out yet. Not that I'd expect her to hear me out even if I did. I just-
lines.zh: 说实话，我还想对她说更多。只是我还没把那些东西理顺。不过就算理顺了，我也不指望她会听进去。我只是——

lines.en: I don't know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: I want to know how she came to be like this...
lines.zh: 我想知道她是怎么会变成这样的……

lines.en: And why I seem to be the one person she refuses to get close to no matter what.
lines.zh: 也想不通为什么不管发生什么，我似乎都是那个她死活不肯靠近的人。

lines.en: $ mayadorm10 = True
$ maya_love += 1
Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!
lines.zh: Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！

lines.en: You can now spend time with her in her dorm!
lines.zh: 你现在可以去她宿舍找她了！

lines.en: She just won't like it very much.
lines.zh: 只是她不会太乐意。
